summary: Implements Math.tanh in crates/kahvi-builtins/src/math/tanh.rs, following the five spec steps in order. Step 1 calls ops::to_number(agent, x)? and propagates abrupt completions. Step 2 returns n for NaN and for ±0 (n == 0.0 is true for -0.0, and n is returned unchanged, so the sign is preserved). Steps 3 and 4 return ±1 for ±Infinity. Step 5 returns n.tanh(), which the spec allows as an implementation approximation. The only file touched is the in-scope one. The step comments sit directly above their code. No test-shaped branches, no swallowed errors, no placeholder values. The gate report shows build and clippy passing and 2 new test262 passes with no regressions.
